purpose: Define pricing model for stablecoin pegging (e.g., USDC = 1 USD) via oracle consensus

priceFeedModel.description: Stable-value oracles report confidence intervals rather than point prices. Settlement uses median price; de-pegging triggers if any oracle deviates > tolerance.

recoverySteps: broadcast depeg event to all apps
allow redemptions at last-known-good price for 1 hour
escalate to governance for corrective action

oracleDisagreement.action: settlement blocked, manual operator review required

dataQualityRequirements.stalenessLimit: if no update in 5 minutes, mark oracle as offline
dataQualityRequirements.failoverTimeout: if 2+ oracles offline, require manual override
dataQualityRequirements.signingRequirement: each price update must be signed by oracle operator key

riskMitigations.sybil_attack: Require independent operator keys for each oracle source; prevent key sharing
riskMitigations.price_manipulation: Supermajority consensus (in stable-value context, relax to majority 3-of-5) requires attacker to compromise 3 independent CEXes
riskMitigations.feed_staleness: 5-minute limit prevents settlement on stale data; automated alerts if staleness detected
riskMitigations.confidence_band: narrow band (±0.01%) forces settlement accuracy; prevents accidental de-pegging

exampleScenarios.scenario: USDC briefly depeg (Flash loan attack attempt)
exampleScenarios.consensusResult: FAIL - Coinbase outside band, only 2-of-3 agree
exampleScenarios.action: Settlement blocked; manual operator review triggered

exampleScenarios.consensusResult: FAIL - Only 1-of-3 online, cannot form consensus
exampleScenarios.action: Await Kraken/Binance recovery (up to 5 min), or trigger manual override after timeout

implementationChecklist: Deploy oracle listener for Coinbase, Kraken, Binance APIs
Log all price updates to attestation registry
Test scenario: rapid price swings (recovery behavior)
Deploy monitoring dashboards (price divergence, staleness, consensus rate)
Document manual override procedures for operators
notes: Stable-value requires tighter consensus and narrower deviation bands than general commodity pricing. This spec assumes 3 independent CEX sources (Coinbase, Kraken, Binance); adapt sources as needed for Kaspa ecosystem.
